description: Pads expander: it splits one polyphonic lane, such as velocity or aftertouch, into sixteen mono outputs, one per note Pads has learned; it goes immediately to the right of Pads or of another PadX

inputs.text: The polyphonic cable to split up, usually the velocity, aftertouch or retrigger output of whatever feeds Pads its pitch and gate

outputs.text: Whatever this lane currently carries for the note learned into the matching cell of Pads, or 0V while that cell has no note, its note is not held, or this cable has too few channels to reach it

notes: the field on the panel is a label to click and type into; it renames the tooltips on this module's jacks and changes nothing about the signal
the label fills itself in from the first cable patched in while it is empty, taking eight characters of the source jack's name, and empties again when that cable is pulled out
the lamp is yellow while nothing is patched into the lane, red while this cable has a different channel count from the pitch and gate cable feeding Pads, and green when the two match
with no Pads to the left, directly or through other expanders, every output stays at 0V
several of these can be chained, one per lane, in any order; each passes the note mapping on to the next
a label typed in by hand is never cleared automatically; only one that filled itself in from a cable is
